answer: An Oasis-dawn fresh-task bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credit and claims a fresh dawn task at the oasis depot, key-signed on the public dawn board. A gale auditor replays the task log; copying or renting a task burns the 70 bond and adds a 20 fine. Each task costs 40 plus a 70 bond, so 1,000 fakes spend 40,000 on fees and tie up 70,000 to chase a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 40 once and reclaims the 70 after a clean epoch.
